buildCommand: echo "SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL" > .env && echo "SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY" >> .env && flutter/bin/flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs && flutter/bin/flutter build web --release
installCommand: if cd flutter; then git pull && cd .. ; else git clone -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git; fi && flutter/bin/flutter doctor && flutter/bin/flutter clean && flutter/bin/flutter config --enable-web && flutter/bin/flutter pub get
